topics.name: Clothes

He's got a dark suit and a blue tie.

She's got long, curly brown hair.

topics.name: Personality

topics.name: Places in a town

topics.name: Giving directions
topics.intro: Ask the way and explain how to get somewhere.
phrases: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

Cross the street and the bank is on your right.

topics.name: Where things are

The keys are inside the drawer.

topics.name: Times of day
topics.intro: Talk about the time and your daily routine.

topics.name: Animals

I'd like to have a horse one day.

topics.name: Countries and nationalities
topics.intro: Say where people and things are from.

topics.name: Food
topics.intro: Name fruit, vegetables, meat, fish and other food.

topics.name: Meals and drinks
topics.intro: Talk about meals and drinks, and say how food tastes.
phrases: I usually have dinner at around nine o'clock.
I'd like a sparkling water, please.

topics.name: Family
topics.intro: Talk about the people in your family.
phrases: I live with my parents and my younger sister.
I've got one brother and two cousins.

topics.name: Work and jobs

phrases: I work as a receptionist in a hotel.

I get on well with my colleagues.
I have a part-time job at the weekend.

topics.name: Restaurants and hotels
topics.intro: Book a table or a room and ask for what you need.
phrases: I'd like to book a table for two, please.
Do you have any rooms available this weekend?
I need a double room for three nights.
Is breakfast included?
Could we have the bill, please?

topics.name: Hobbies and free time
topics.intro: Talk about what you do in your free time, and how often.

I usually go out with my friends at the weekend.

topics.name: Celebrations
topics.intro: Talk about special days and parties.

topics.name: Weather and seasons

topics.name: Transport

phrases: I usually go to work by bus.
I prefer travelling by train because it's comfortable.
I don't like flying because I'm afraid of it.
It takes me twenty minutes to get to work.
I usually go to school on foot.
